name: Cragpool Lake
summary: At Cragpool Lake, the Venture Company’s timber structure looms over the dark water in Windshear Crag.

sections.title: Industrial Encroachment
sections.body: Cragpool Lake lies beneath a vast timber structure built by the Venture Company in Windshear Crag. Platforms cross above the water, where Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle watches operations across the mountain valley. Venture Company workers occupy the platforms overhead.

faq.q: What is the massive wooden structure hanging over the lake?
faq.answer: The Venture Company built a vast wooden structure over the lake to manage its logging and mining in Windshear Crag. Platforms and heavy machinery span the water.

faq.q: Who oversees the operations at Cragpool Lake?
faq.answer: Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle oversees the operations at Cragpool Lake. The Venture Company operative watches deforestation and resource extraction across Windshear Crag from the high scaffolding.
Venture Company workers operate on the platforms above the lake. Their armed presence makes the site dangerous for intruders.

faq.q: Has the Venture Company abandoned Cragpool Lake?
faq.answer: No. Venture Company workers and Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle occupy the structure above the lake.

angles.text: The timber scaffolding and cantilevered machinery above Cragpool Lake show goblin industry built quickly, heavily loaded, and indifferent to the land beneath it.
As a druid, you see the runoff, timber platforms, and disruption around Cragpool Lake as a scar on Stonetalon. They warp the local ecosystem and displace native wildlife.
